description: Personal memory curation and recall: managing core user identity, preferences, rules, and searching/storing long-term episodic facts.
routing_rules: Assign when the user asks to recall personal preferences, update user rules/profile, remember specific facts, or delete outdated memories.

tools.name: memory_update_profile
tools.description: Appends, updates, or deletes structured markdown sections or key-value items in the user's core profile.

tools.name: memory_update_account
tools.description: Adds, updates, or removes connected user accounts and email aliases in accounts.md.

tools.name: memory_store_fact
tools.description: Stores an atomic episodic memory fact or research note with vector embedding in FAISS and SQLite.

tools.name: memory_search
tools.description: Semantically searches long-term episodic memory facts and user profile by natural language query.

tools.name: memory_delete
tools.description: Deletes a specific memory record from FAISS and SQLite by its unique record ID.
